parties.note: Leading party of the United Front (Northern Alliance). After 2001 it continued in the Islamic Republic: 22 seats in 2005 and 17 in 2010 by the Wikipedia affiliation tables. Salahuddin Rabbani was chosen as leader after his father's death on 20 September 2011. Founded in 1972 according to Wikipedia, which adds that it may date from the 1960s. Colour from the party's infobox.

parties.note: Founded by Abdul Rashid Dostum in 1992; part of the United Front. Largest party by affiliation in the 2005 Wolesi Jirga (33 seats). Its infobox also lists Batur Dostum as president. The colour is a placeholder; no party colour was found in the source.
